title: When is more search useful? An Empirical Study of Search Utility in Quality-Aware Decoding for Machine Translation
abstract: arXiv:2610.32679v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quality-Aware Decoding (QAD) improves machine translation through test-time scaling, generating multiple candidate translations and selecting the final output with a quality-aware decoder. Usually the same candidate budget N is spent on every source sentence, assuming that all inputs require the same amount of search. We show that this assumption does not hold and that the quality gain obtained from additional candidates varies across sentences. We study search utility through three quantities: total scaling gain, how much quality a sentence can gain from a much larger candidate pool; marginal scaling gain, the expected gain from generating one additional batch of candidates; and the sampling saturation point, the candidate budget required to realize most of the total scaling gain. translated_title: 何时更多的搜索才有用？机器翻译质量感知解码中搜索效用的实证研究
translated_abstract: 质量感知解码通过测试时扩展来提升机器翻译，即生成多个候选译文，再由质量感知解码器选出最终输出。通常做法是对每个源句子都花费相同的候选预算N，假定所有输入需要同等的搜索量。我们证明这一假设并不成立，且额外候选带来的质量提升在不同句子之间存在差异。我们通过三个量来研究搜索效用：总扩展增益，即一个句子能从更大的候选池中获得多少质量提升；边际扩展增益，即额外生成一批候选所期望带来的增益；以及采样饱和点，即实现大部分总扩展增益所需的候选预算。我们考察了用于预测这三个量的两类信息来源：在候选集扩展之前即可获得的信号，以及从候选集计算得到的统计量。
tldr: 该论文提出“搜索效用”的三个量化指标（总扩展增益、边际扩展增益、采样饱和点），实证表明机器翻译中不同句子从额外候选中获益的程度差异显著，从而为自适应分配搜索预算提供了依据。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces three metrics of search utility—total scaling gain, marginal scaling gain, and sampling saturation point—empirically showing that quality gains from additional candidates vary substantially across sentences in machine translation, enabling adaptive allocation of search budgets in Quality-Aware Decoding.
